translationRepairs: The sorcerer-subversive Zhang Roundong was executed.
The sorcerer-subversive Zhang Yuanguang was executed.
張圓光 is a personal name read Zhang Yuanguang; "Roundong" is a garbled rendering of 圓光.
On bingxu day Keshig Naqun, Prince of Xiping, and others were granted 11,521 ingots of paper currency.
On bingxu day Naqun and others of the keshig (guard) of the Prince of Xiping were granted 11,521 ingots of paper currency.
西平王怯薛那懷等 means "Naqun and others of the Prince of Xiping’s keshig"; the English wrongly makes Naqun the Prince of Xiping.
Grand Steward Anige and acting minister of works Naqun were ordered to make and decorate copper wheel instruments, clepsydra, and sundial.
Minister over the Masses (situ) Anige and acting minister of works Naqun were ordered to make and decorate copper wheel instruments, clepsydra, and sundial.
司徒 is the high honorary office Minister over the Masses (situ), not a "Grand Steward".
Campaigning against Burma was discussed; Da Bu was made right vice censor and Yehan Dejin associate administrator to lead troops on the expedition.
Campaigning against Burma was discussed; Da Bu was made right assistant councillor and Yehan Dejin associate administrator to lead troops on the expedition.
右丞 here is the branch-secretariat office right assistant councillor (右丞), not a censorate post.
On wuxu day military supplies were issued to commander-in-chief Qi Gongzhi at Bie Shibali.
On wuxu day military supplies were issued to Qi Gongzhi, commander-in-chief of Beshbaligh (別十八里).
別十八里元帥 is the commander-in-chief of Beshbaligh; "Bie Shibali" is an unrecognisable transcription and the supplies went to the commander, not to a place.
On wuwu day silver notes and clothing in graded amounts were granted to Yunnan envoys and those below Bashiba of the Shaanxi branch secretariat.
On wuwu day silver notes and clothing in graded amounts were granted to Yunnan envoys and Baba, assistant administrator of the Shaanxi branch secretariat, and those below him.
陜西簽省八八以下: 八八 is the personal name Baba (not "Bashiba"), and 簽省 is his office (assistant administrator of the branch secretariat).
Yidu qianhu Wang Zhu, because Ahmad had corrupted the state and harmed the people, joined Gao Heshang in a plot to kill him.
Yidu qianhu Wang Zhu, because Ahmad had corrupted the state and harmed the people, plotted with Gao Heshang and killed him.
與高和尚合謀殺之 states that they plotted together and killed Ahmad; the English leaves the killing as a mere plot.
His followers Wu Man and Zhang Fei welcomed the enemy and were executed on the spot.
His followers Wu Man and Zhang Fei resisted the government troops and were executed on the spot.
迎敵 means to meet and engage the enemy in battle (i.e., they resisted the government forces), not to "welcome" the enemy.
Because Ahmad's son Husin, left associate of the Jianghuai branch secretariat, was guiltier than his father, investigation was discussed.
Because Ahmad's son Husin, manager of governmental affairs (pingzhang) of the Jianghuai branch secretariat, was guiltier than his father, investigation was discussed.
平章政事 is the office pingzhang zhengshi (manager of governmental affairs); "left associate" mistranslates it.
On gengxu day the branch censorate said, "Ala Haiya took submitted people as slaves and claimed them as booty from campaigns."
On gengxu day the branch censorate said, "Alihaiya took submitted people as slaves and claimed them as booty from campaigns."
阿裏海牙 is transcribed Alihaiya (Ariq Qaya); "Ala Haiya" corrupts the name.
3,758 horses, camels, cattle, sheep, and donkeys belonging to Ahmad were registered; Ahmad's crimes were pursued, his coffin opened, and his corpse exposed outside the Tongxuan Gate.
3,758 horses, camels, cattle, sheep, and donkeys belonging to Ahmad were registered; Ahmad's crimes were pursued, his coffin opened, and his corpse desecrated outside the Tongxuan Gate.
戮其屍 means the corpse was mutilated/desecrated as punishment, not merely "exposed".

On gengchen day deliberation was held on building ships at Pingluan Prefecture; 9,000 troops and civilians combined were mobilized, with temechi Bieyadai placed in command to cut timber in the mountains and also take it from temples, monasteries, and graves, the state paying fair value; Sangge was also ordered to send men to supervise.

On gengchen day deliberation was held on building ships at Pingluan Prefecture; 9,000 troops and civilians combined were mobilized, with tammachi Boyaodai placed in command to cut timber in the mountains and also take it from temples, monasteries, and graves, the state paying fair value; Sangge was also ordered to send men to supervise.
探馬赤 is the tammachi (garrison) troops and 伯要帶 is read Boyaodai; both are garbled in the English.

Gansu branch secretariat left vice minister Maitingding was made right vice chancellor of the Central Secretariat, and branch censorate censor-in-chief Zhang Xiongfei was made associate administrator.

Gansu branch secretariat left vice minister Maitingding was made right vice chancellor of the Central Secretariat, and branch censorate vice censor-in-chief Zhang Xiongfei was made associate administrator.
御史中丞 is the vice censor-in-chief; censor-in-chief is 御史大夫.

On dingsi day Yixibuxue was attacked and his territory entirely pacified; three-route darughachis were established, garrison troops were left to hold it, Yarlaq Hai was ordered to command overall, and Yesudai'er was made grand commander and pacification commissioner.

On dingsi day Yixibuxue was attacked and its territory entirely pacified; three-route darughachis were established, garrison troops were left to hold it, Yarlaq Hai was ordered to command overall, and Yesudai'er was made grand commander and pacification commissioner.
亦奚不薛 is a region/people, not a person; 其地 is "its territory".
On xinyou day Hao Zhen's coffin was opened and his corpse exposed.
On xinyou day Hao Zhen's coffin was opened and his corpse desecrated.
戮其尸 means the corpse was mutilated/desecrated as punishment, not merely "exposed".
On dingchou day chief commander Wang Zha'er was dismissed and his patent of appointment and tiger tally were confiscated.
On dingchou day chief commander Wang Zhalaerdai was dismissed and his patent of appointment and tiger tally were confiscated.
汪劄剌兒帶 is the full name Wang Zhalaerdai; the English truncates it to "Wang Zha'er".
On yimao day the emperor held court in the main hall and received New Year's greetings from the crown prince, princes, and all officials.
On yimao day the emperor held court in the main hall and received congratulations from the crown prince, princes, and all officials.
朝賀 here follows the emperor’s birthday festival of the 8th month; nothing in the text refers to New Year.
On bingchen day Nie'utiedie was banished to garrison Champa to redeem his crime.
On bingchen day Niewudiena was banished to garrison Champa to redeem his crime.
捏兀迭納 is read Niewudiena; "Nie'utiedie" corrupts and truncates the name.

You Xian asked to abolish the Lian and Haizhou garrison farms and place their affairs under civilian officials; his request was granted, and You Xian was additionally made grand councillor and sent to administer the branch secretariat at Yangzhou.

You Xian asked to abolish the Lian and Haizhou garrison farms and place their affairs under civilian officials; his request was granted, and You Xian was made manager of governmental affairs (pingzhang), administering the branch secretariat at Yangzhou.
平章政事 is pingzhang zhengshi (manager of governmental affairs), not "grand councillor" (丞相); 仍 does not mean "additionally".
Campaign commissioner Yang Tingjian won over the overseas countries, and the southern fan all sent envoys with tribute.
Campaign commissioner Yang Tingjian won over the overseas countries, and the southern foreign countries (南番) all sent envoys with tribute.
南番 means the southern foreign countries; "southern fan" leaves the term untranslated and unintelligible.
The lord of Sumudusu also sent two envoys.
The lord of Sumudusu, Tuhanbadi, also sent two envoys.
The English omits the ruler’s name 土漢八的 (Tuhanbadi) given in the source.
On dingmao day Annam sent tribute of rhinoceros, elephants, gold and silver vessels, incense, and medicines.
On dingmao day Annam sent tribute of rhinoceroses, gold and silver vessels, incense, and medicines.
犀兕 are rhinoceros-type animals; nothing in the source mentions elephants.
Ma Lin of Husin's faction was dismissed as left associate of the Jianghuai branch secretariat.
Ma Lin of Husin's faction was dismissed as associate administrator of the Jianghuai branch secretariat.
參知政事 is the office associate administrator; "left associate" is a mistranslation.
In the eleventh month, on wu day, a utilization treasury was built at Shangdu.
In the eleventh month, on wuwu day, a utilization treasury was built at Shangdu.
The day is 戊午 (wuwu); "wu day" drops half of the sexagenary designation.

Kong Shu, hereditary Duke of Confucius from Jiangnan, came to audience; he was made chancellor of the National University and concurrently overseer of Zhedong schools, with salary and a seal to maintain the forest temple granted on the spot.

Kong Zhu, the Jiangnan hereditary Duke for Propagating the Sage (Yansheng gong), came to audience; he was made chancellor of the National University and concurrently overseer of Zhedong schools, with salary and a seal to maintain the forest temple granted on the spot.
孔洙 is read Kong Zhu, and 衍聖公 is the hereditary title Duke for Propagating the Sage, not "Duke of Confucius".
Chief merit commissioner Tuolie was dismissed; Buddhist rites he had arranged at government expense were all recovered.
Chief merit commissioner Tuolie was dismissed; the government property he had wasted on Buddhist services was all recovered from him.
其修設佛事妄費官物，皆征還之: what was recovered was the government property he squandered, not the rites.
On renyin day Zhang Wenqian, left associate of the Central Secretariat, was made deputy commissioner of the Military Affairs Bureau.
On renyin day Zhang Wenqian, left assistant councillor of the Central Secretariat, was made deputy commissioner of the Military Affairs Bureau.
中書左丞 is the left assistant councillor; "left associate" mistranslates it.
On yiwei day Central Secretariat officials said, "Duke of Pingyuan Zhao Yourui, Duke of Ying Zhao Qi, and Hanlin direct academician Zhao Yubiao should all reside at Shangdu."
On yiwei day Central Secretariat officials said, "Duke of Pingyuan Commandery Zhao Yurui, Duke of Ying Zhao Zhi, and Hanlin auxiliary academician Zhao Yupiao should all reside at Shangdu."
趙與芮/趙鳷/趙與票 are read Zhao Yurui, Zhao Zhi, Zhao Yupiao; 平原郡公 is a commandery duke and 直學士 is auxiliary academician.
The Emperor said, "Yourui is old; he should remain in Dadu; the rest as proposed."
The Emperor said, "Yurui is old; he should remain in Dadu; the rest as proposed."
與芮 is read Yurui (與 = yu), as in the preceding entry.

On guimao day censor-in-chief Cui Yu said, "Censorial officials, regarding the gains and losses of state affairs, the welfare and hardship of the people, and the upright and corrupt among officials—even princes, dukes, generals, and ministers—should all impeach and investigate.

On guimao day vice censor-in-chief Cui Yu said, "Censorial officials, regarding the gains and losses of state affairs, the welfare and hardship of the people, and the upright and corrupt among officials—even princes, dukes, generals, and ministers—should all impeach and investigate.
御史中丞 is the vice censor-in-chief; censor-in-chief is 御史大夫.
Right associate of the Central Secretariat Zhachan was made co-administrator.
Right assistant councillor of the Central Secretariat Zhasan was made manager of governmental affairs (pingzhang).
中書右丞 is right assistant councillor, 平章政事 is manager of governmental affairs, and 劄散 is read Zhasan.
Horses, cattle, and sheep were granted in graded amounts to Tachar and others under Prince North An.
Horses, cattle, and sheep were granted in graded amounts to Tachar and others of the household of the imperial son, the Prince of Bei'an.
皇子北安王位下 is the household of the imperial son, the Prince of Bei'an (北安王); "Prince North An" garbles the title and omits 皇子.
On xinyou day a seal was granted to Prince Chubo, and army notes were granted as rewards to Prince Bichitemür and consort Changji.
On xinyou day a seal was granted to Prince Chubo, and army notes were granted as rewards to Prince Bichitemür and imperial son-in-law Changji.
駙馬 is the title imperial son-in-law; "consort" suggests a ruler’s spouse.
On yichou day King Wang Chun of Goryeo sent the envoy Wuladai to present four hundred bolts of kasaya cloth, thread silk, and the like as tribute.
On yichou day King Wang Chun of Goryeo sent the envoy Wuladai to present four hundred bolts of cotton cloth, thread silk, and the like as tribute.
㲲布 is cotton cloth; "kasaya" (a monk’s robe) is not in the source.
On jisi day the moon transgressed the Maid of the Charioteer in the Charioteer.
On jisi day the moon transgressed the Imperial Maid star of Xuanyuan.
軒轅御女 is the Imperial Maid (Yunü) star of the Xuanyuan asterism; the English duplicates "Charioteer" and garbles the star name.
On dingchou day pacification commissioner Yang Tingbi was made pacification commissioner, granted bow, arrows, saddle, and bridle, and sent to instruct the lands of Zhulan and others.

On dingchou day campaign-pacification commissioner (zhaotao) Yang Tingbi was made pacification commissioner (xuanwei shi), granted bow, arrows, saddle, and bridle, and sent to instruct the lands of Zhulan and others.
招討 (zhaotao) and 宣慰使 (xuanwei shi) are different offices; the English renders both as "pacification commissioner", making the promotion meaningless.
On jimao day all armies were ordered to practice boats and oars; 8,000 ingots of notes were granted at Longxing, Xunde, and other places for coordinated grain purchases to sustain them.
On jimao day all armies were ordered to practice boats and oars; 8,000 ingots of notes were granted at Longxing, Xuande, and other places for coordinated grain purchases to sustain them.
On the wuxu days of the second month of spring and autumn, sacrifices were made to the soil-and-grain altars and Lord Wucheng.
On the first wu day of the middle month of spring and of autumn, sacrifices were made to the soil-and-grain altars and Lord Wucheng.
仲月上戊日 is the first wu day of the middle month of each season, not "wuxu days of the second month".
Wanhu Buduman was ordered to garrison Jingchi.
Wanhu Buduman was ordered to garrison Jinchi.
金齒 is read Jinchi ("Gold Teeth").
Kuokuonitudun was put in charge of the Jiang-Huai branch secretariat; when faults were reported against him, Unuhudai and Bayan were ordered to assist him.
Kuokuo Nidun was put in charge of the Jiang-Huai branch secretariat; when faults were reported against him, Unuhudai and Bayan were ordered to assist him.
闊闊你敦 has four syllables (Kuo-kuo-ni-dun); the English inserts a spurious "tu".
A seal was granted to royal tutor Unaqutipch; relay horses were granted to officials taking posts in Western Sichuan, Fujian, and the Two Guang.
A seal was granted to princely tutor Wunahu Tiezhi; relay horses were granted to officials taking posts in Western Sichuan, Fujian, and the Two Guang.
兀訥忽帖只 is garbled as "Unaqutipch"; 王傅 is the tutor of a prince’s household.
Atahai was dispatched to garrison Quxian; Handulu Shimi led newly submitted Ganzhou troops to Wandan.
Atahai was dispatched to garrison Quxian; Handulumishi led newly submitted Ganzhou troops to Woduan (Khotan).
漢都魯迷失 ends in 迷失 (mishi), not "Shimi"; 斡端 is Woduan (Khotan), not "Wandan".

The Fujian circuit pacification commission was abolished; a branch secretariat was re-established at Zhangzhou; Central Secretariat right vice chancellor Zhang Hui was made grand councillor and censor-in-chief Esentemur left vice chancellor; both directed branch secretariat affairs.

The Fujian circuit pacification commission was abolished; a branch secretariat was re-established at Zhangzhou; Central Secretariat right vice chancellor Zhang Hui was made manager of governmental affairs (pingzhang zhengshi) and vice censor-in-chief Esentemur left vice chancellor; both directed branch secretariat affairs.
平章政事 is manager of governmental affairs, not grand councillor; 御史中丞 is vice censor-in-chief.
On gengyin day Yalihai was ordered to garrison and guard Yixibuxi.
On gengyin day Yaolahai was ordered to garrison and guard Yixibuxue.
藥剌海 is Yaolahai (cf. s0295) and 亦奚不薛 is Yixibuxue; the English garbles both.
Grand marshal Yesu'er returned from Yixibuxi, encamped at Chengdu, requested an audience, and was granted it; men were still dispatched to garrison strategic passes.
Supreme marshal Yesuda'er returned from Yixibuxue, encamped at Chengdu, requested an audience, and was granted it; men were still dispatched to garrison strategic passes.
也速答兒 drops a syllable in "Yesu'er"; 亦奚不薛 is Yixibuxue; 都元帥 is supreme marshal.
On renchen day Atahai requested naval-trained army officers for the Japan expedition; marshals Zhang Lin, pacification commissioner Zhang Xuan, and supervisor Zhu Qing and others were ordered to go.

On renchen day Atahai requested naval-trained army officers for the Japan expedition; marshal Zhang Lin, campaign-pacification commissioner (zhaotao) Zhang Xuan, and route commander Zhu Qing and others were ordered to go.
元帥 is singular for Zhang Lin; 招討 is a campaign-pacification commissioner; 總管 is a route commander.

Censor-in-chief Cui Yu said, "Bandits in Jiangnan have risen one after another, all because sailors are conscripted and sea ships are built until the people cannot survive; the Japan expedition should for the time being be halted.

Vice censor-in-chief Cui Yu said, "Bandits in Jiangnan have risen one after another, all because sailors are conscripted and sea ships are built until the people cannot survive; the Japan expedition should for the time being be halted.
御史中丞 is vice censor-in-chief; censor-in-chief is 御史大夫.
An edict ordered Ala Haiya to deploy 7,000 Han troops and 8,000 newly submitted troops and assign them to Suodu for the campaign.
An edict ordered Alihaiya to deploy 7,000 Han troops and 8,000 newly submitted troops and assign them to Suodu for the campaign.
阿裏海牙 is Alihaiya (Ariq Qaya); "Ala Haiya" drops the li syllable.
Following censor-in-chief Cui Yu's memorial, the selection of maidens in all routes was abolished.
Following vice censor-in-chief Cui Yu's memorial, the selection of maidens in all routes was abolished.
御史中丞 is vice censor-in-chief.
Hainan Four Prefectures pacification commissioner Zhu Guobao asked for additional troops to campaign against the King of Champa; an edict granted him 15,000 men from Ala Haiya's army.
Hainan Four Prefectures pacification commissioner Zhu Guobao asked for additional troops to campaign against the King of Champa; an edict granted him 15,000 men from Alihaiya's army.
阿裏海牙 is Alihaiya (Ariq Qaya).
The Maritime and Eastern Liaodong circuit surveillance commission was established to investigate the Jurchen and Sushen tribes.
The Maritime and Eastern Liaodong circuit surveillance commission was established to investigate the Jurchen and Shui Dada tribes.
水達達 is the Shui Dada (Water Tatars), not the ancient Sushen.

On xinhai day Sichuan branch secretariat associate administrator Qurugjin and others pacified the Nine Streams and Eighteen Caves, brought their chiefs to court, fixed their territories, established prefectures and counties, and placed them under Shunyuan Route pacification commission.

On xinhai day Sichuan branch secretariat associate administrator Qulijisi and others pacified the Nine Streams and Eighteen Caves, brought their chiefs to court, fixed their territories, established prefectures and counties, and placed them under Shunyuan Route pacification commission.
曲立吉思 is Qulijisi; "Qurugjin" does not match the characters.
In the eighth month, on guiwei day, Minglicha was made privy councillor with charge of state affairs and deliberated on public business.
In the eighth month, on guiwei day, Minglicha was made manager of important military and state affairs (pingzhang junguo zhongshi) and deliberated on public business.
平章軍國重事 is a senior honorary chancellorship, not "privy councillor".
斡脫 is the ortoq merchant association, not "Otrot".
On gisi day Wanduan pacification commissioner Liu En presented fine grain, one stalk each of nine-, seven-, and six-ear grain growing from a single spike.
On guisi day Woduan (Khotan) pacification commissioner Liu En presented fine grain, one stalk each of nine-, seven-, and six-ear grain growing from a single spike.
癸巳 is guisi; 斡端 is Woduan (Khotan), not "Wanduan".
On jiawu day Grand Councillor Zharsan was made vice director of the Privy Council.
On jiawu day Manager of governmental affairs Zhasan was made vice director of the Privy Council.
平章政事 is manager of governmental affairs, not grand councillor; 劄散 is read Zhasan.
An edict ordered Bolinjidai and Shi Bi and others to lead 22,000 troops to suppress and pacify them.
An edict ordered Bulinjidai and Shi Bi and others to lead 22,000 troops to suppress and pacify them.
卜憐吉帶 is read Bulinjidai.

unresolvedReferences.description: 兄弟桂龍、滿安 may be the brothers of Chen Diaoyan or of his father Wengui; the chapter does not settle the referent of 兄弟, so the edges are recorded as uncertain kin-of links.
合納塔兒 and 八隻 are read as the names of impoverished individuals granted money; the chapter does not exclude that they name groups or units.
忽蘭 and 塔剌不罕 are read as the names of people whose households were assigned to the crown prince; the chapter does not exclude that they are group or place names.
兀奴忽魯帶 (s0365) may be the same man as 兀奴忽帶 (s0354), who was assigned to the Jiang-Huai branch secretariat; the chapter writes the names differently, so they are kept separate.
The Atahai sent to garrison Quxian (s0379) is kept separate from Atahai, chancellor of the Japan-expedition branch secretariat; the chapter does not say whether they are the same man.
也速答兒 (s0389, supreme marshal back from Yixibuxue) is read as the same man as 也速帶兒 (s0405, right assistant councillor in the southwest campaigns); the characters differ slightly.
The chapter does not name the Prince of Qin who received the Shaanxi surveillance fines.
Ali (阿裏), route commander of Shunyuan, and Ali (阿利), the Luogui chieftain, both in s0482, are read as one man; the characters differ.
怯兒合思 may be an ethnonym (Kirghiz) rather than a person; it is kept as a person with uncertain certainty.
The Bayan whose memorial on the Song hand-tally troops was adopted is identified with Chancellor Bayan (s0411); this is strongly inferred.
阿速帶軍 may mean the troops of a commander named Asudai or an Asud (Alan) unit; it is kept as a person with uncertain certainty.
撒合兒 and 兀魯, said to be under the princes, may be unit or group names rather than individuals.
子童 of Shizhou is read as the rebel’s name; it could also be a descriptive term.
